title: Experts disagree on new evals/fixture/scaffold.sh
context:
Chief architect: both claims want a half-built fixture to fail the case; the security wording also bounds what an outside-sandbox script may touch, and set -euo pipefail is what delivers the qa error path

Target: new evals/fixture/scaffold.sh
- security-auditor: The shared scaffold runs outside the sandbox, so it only writes inside the current workspace, makes no network call, quotes every path built from BASH_SOURCE (the local checkout path has a space), and runs with set -euo pipefail so a half-built fixture fails the case instead of running loose.
- qa-engineer: Error path: when git init, the commit, or the framework-path.txt write fails, the scaffold exits non-zero so the case errors instead of running in a half-built workspace and grading a false firewall block.
